context_rules.exit_status_flip: Protocol exit statuses are zero or one; flip zero to one or one to zero instead of producing an unexpected status two.
context_rules.warning_category: Replace a valid Perl warning category with another known category instead of generating a compilation error.
context_rules.integer_literal_domain: Decimal integer boundary replacements remain nonnegative; protocol exits zero/one use the separately declared status flip.
context_rules.interpolated_string: Whole quoted strings, including interpolated strings, use the declared empty-or-nonempty string replacement; interpolation is not silently omitted.

structural_operators.=: binding or assignment syntax; no type-independent literal replacement is declared
